title: Tableau's Plunge Drags Salesforce, Workday on Growth Concern
主要内容: Tableau Software Inc. experienced a significant drop in its value after failing to meet fourth-quarter estimates, which led to a broader decline in the software sector. The company's license revenue fell below expectations for the first time since its 2013 initial public offering, according to Abhey Lamba, an analyst at Mizuho Securities USA Inc. This underperformance triggered a sharp decline in shares of major software companies, including Workday, which saw its stock drop by 16 percent, marking its largest single-day decline since October 2012. Salesforce.com and Adobe Systems also faced substantial declines, with Salesforce falling 13 percent and Adobe dropping 8.3 percent.
